zh: 手机端（iOS / Android）侧边栏「置顶」分组支持点击折叠并记住状态（搜索时自动展开）；发送超过 6 行的长消息自动折叠，支持点击「展开全文 / 收起全文」。
AI 月报支持将已保存报告设为/取消「默认显示」；优化 AI 看板下拉列表长名称溢出、桌面端工程折叠与悬浮提示收起体验。
en: Mobile (iOS & Android) sidebar Pinned section now supports collapsing with persisted state (auto-expands during search), and user messages over 6 lines auto-fold with a Show more / Show less toggle.
AI Monthly Report now supports toggling a default report; fixed AI BI menu overflow for long board titles, refined workspace project folding and tooltip dismissal, and refreshed built-in tool guides.
